content: ध्वननम् [ध्वन्-करणे ल्युट्] .²1 Sounding. .²2 Hinting at, suggesting or implying (as a meaning). .²3 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) The same as व्यञ्जना <ab>q. v.</ab>, or that power of a word or sentence by virtue of which it conveys a sense different from its primary or secondary meaning, suggestive power; <ab>cf.</ab> अञ्जन also वृत्तिर्व्यञ्जनध्वननगमनप्रत्यायनादिव्यपदेशविषया व्यञ्जना नाम <ls>S. D.</ls> .²4 Humming, indistinct utterance.
